verdict: PASS - frozen held-out qualification completed, 12/12 fixtures across two trials, zero critical failures
construct_validity_caveats: The held-out pack author, the candidate runtime and one of the two judges are all gemini-3.5-flash-lite. The same model family authored the test, sat the test and graded half of it. eval-integrity-and-regression.md directs that such an evaluation's independence be downgraded. This was preregistered in the cycle before this session and was not changed here, because changing it would alter the frozen cycle.

All 24 gradings returned a minimum elicited score of 2, a ceiling effect. Both judges did discriminate correctly on the six calibration cases, which is real evidence they are not simply agreeing, but a uniform top score across every fixture and dimension is weak at distinguishing strong from adequate work.
Two clean trials satisfy the frozen protocol's repeated-trial rule, but two trials is a thin basis for estimating stochastic reliability.
PASS is scoped to this exact artifact digest, this held-out pack and this declared runtime. It is not transferable to a specialization or a composed agent.
